newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GAZPROM BANK UNIT AEB MULLS BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: GAZPROM BANK UNIT AEB MULLS BOND ISSUE.

text.p: Altalanos Ertekforgalmi Bank Rt (AEB), the Hungarian subsidiary of the Russian gas firm Gazprom's banking unit, is planning to issue bonds guaranteed by Gazprom, the bank's chairman said on Tuesday.
"We are in the final stages of negotiations with Gazprom on the bond issue," Mikhail Nikolayevich Rakhimulov told a news conference.
The bond would either be convertable to Gazprom shares or be guaranteed against Gazprom's gas exports, he said.
The bond would be issued in Central European countries in local currencies, he added.
The size of the issue has not been decided, but AEB's financing needs are $250 million, of which a portion is expected to be raised from non-Hungarian commercial banks, he added.
The money would be used to finance the construction of gas-powered power stations in Hungary, and the export of Hungarian-made mills, Ikarus buses, and other machinery to Russia, he added.
